segments.text: THat GOD as he is in himſelfe, cannot be comprehended of any but himſelfe, dwelling in that inacceſſible light, that no eye can attaine unto, whom never man ſaw, nor can ſee; that there is but one God, one Chriſt, one Spirit, one Faith, one Baptiſme; one Rule of holineſſe and obedience for all Saints, at all times, in all places to be obſerved.
